newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 10.

text.p: * H.J. Heinz Co is expected to cut its staff and take a pre-tax charge of more than $500 million in its fiscal fourth quarter ending April 30, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Monday. Heinz closed at 43-3/4 Friday.

* The "Up & Down Wall Street" column in Barron's said "a savvy investor who owns the stock" and sees Chrysalis International Corp, a small biotech firm, growing 20 to 25 percent a year "for quite a spell." The stock closed at 4-3/4.

* Shares in Eli Lilly and Co came under pressure in London after the Wall Street Journal's "Heard on the Street" column said a controversy over its new drug for psychotics "reminded everybody how vulnerable Lilly's still richly valued stock may be."

* CNS Inc shares fell in after-hours trading Friday to 8-3/8 from their closing price of 11-1/4 after the company said it expects first quarter earnings to fall significantly short of analysts' projections.
